description: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation - Sri Lanka Water Aerodromes Regulations No. 1 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Civil Aviation Act, establishing legal requirements and procedures for water aerodrome licensing and operations. It creates a regulatory framework for civil aviation matters, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would make it a government-related type.
